summary: Practise inventory exposure, stock prioritization and recovery decisions for supply disruption. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Inventory contingency planning prepares stock decisions for supplier, transport, or planning-system interruptions. It is for inventory planners, procurement leads, and continuity specialists who need to protect priority service when supply is constrained. Participants assess days of supply and stock criticality, compare allocation and buffer options, map supplier recovery dependencies, and set response triggers using practical inventory controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support inventory decisions when supply, transport, or planning systems become unreliable.
modules: Inventory Position and Days of Supply
prerequisites: Working familiarity with inventory records, replenishment decisions, or supply chain operations is expected. No coding or system configuration is required.
